name: VllmChatClient

test_list.description: POST /tokenize carries the same model, messages, tools, and reasoning projection as Chat Completions with the required vLLM chat flags, and returns validated count and context length.
A provider count greater than max_model_len is returned so callers can trim oversized candidate prompts.
Reject zero counts/context lengths, count-token-list mismatches, and token ids that do not fit TokenCount-compatible u32 values.
Reject raw or encoded prompts beyond configured request bounds without dispatching a request.
Bound response bytes and wait time; reject unsupported endpoint statuses without exposing response bodies, credentials, or request content in errors/debug output.
Match the chat serializer's omission of empty tool arrays.
The tokenizer wrapper dispatches chat through its same configured HTTP owner.

inputs.name: client
inputs.description: Configured transport providing the origin, auth, request bounds, deadlines, retries, and bounded body reader.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: The same structured chat prompt used for streaming, including tools and supported reasoning replay.

output_description: Provider-reported prompt token count and maximum model context length, with strict protocol and size validation.
